Cc: billing@stagingai.com, finance+ops@stagingai.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Annual prepay cadence + VAT routing (StagingAI)

Hi Grace,

Hope you're well. We're kicking off our FY28 financial ops and want to lock the prepay cadence and drawdown windows with Redwood before our audit next month. A few items we need to confirm:

- Final invoice cadence for the annual prepay (monthly tranche vs. quarterly drawdown?)
- Invoice numbering format (we require vendor invoices to contain our PO + the vendor TAX ID)
- VAT handling for EU usage (we'll be reclaiming on our side; we need the EU VAT breakdown on each invoice)
- A single point of contact for collections and VAT evidence requests

Can you share a callable schedule + recommended invoice template so our accounts payable can confirm the remit flow? Attaching our preferred PO template if helpful.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Lee
Head of Finance Operations — StagingAI

Attachments: PO_template_StagingAI.docx (attachment referenced)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan@stagingai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay cadence + VAT routing (StagingAI)

Jordan — thanks for the clear ask and the PO template. We've drafted a recommended cadence and an invoice naming convention for your AP team to review. Key proposals:

1) Cadence: quarterly drawdowns (default) with optional monthly incremental invoices for large prepay balances. Quarterly keeps accounting simple and matches our rollout forecasts. If you need monthly reporting we can provide a monthly statement (no separate invoice) showing tranche depletion.

2) Invoice naming & metadata: Redwood Invoice format: RDW-<YYYYMMDD>-<ACCOUNT>-<INVOICE_SEQ>. Example: RDW-20270301-STAGINGAI-0001. We'll include: PO#, Redwood TAX ID, and the EU VAT breakdown line per jurisdiction.

3) VAT evidence: We can append a VAT appendix to each invoice (separate PDF) that shows usage split by region, VAT charged, and tax rate applied. This is exported from our billing ledger overnight.

4) Contacts: Grace O'Connor (collections lead) and Karthik Iyer (tax/ops). For urgent remit exceptions, cc kimberly_park@redwood.com.

I've attached a working cadence spreadsheet (2027_Q1_prepay_cadence.xlsx) and a sample invoice PDF. Please review and tell us if you prefer monthly invoices instead of quarterly drawdowns.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: 2027_Q1_prepay_cadence.xlsx, sample_invoice_StagingAI_202703.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan@stagingai.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay cadence + VAT routing (StagingAI)

Quick clarifying notes from tax/ops:

- EU VAT: We'll include VAT lines by country when usage is attributable to EU session/region. If StagingAI wants all EU VAT netted to a single country, we can produce a country-aggregated appendix but we'll need a written instruction from your tax team.

- Invoice numbering: If you'd like the PO to drive the invoice number, confirm the PO prefix and we'll mirror it in the RDW reference. Example: if your PO is PO-STG-2027-042, we will emit RDW-<date>-PO-STG-2027-042-001.

- Payment terms: Standard is Net 30 for committed prepay invoices. We can support escrowed retainer instructions if procurement prefers.

If you can confirm the preferred cadence (monthly invoices vs quarterly drawdowns) and PO naming rule, we'll freeze the template and start producing March tranche invoices as of 2027-03-15.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Manager, Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan@stagingai.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay cadence + VAT routing (StagingAI)

Jordan / team — looping in final items from AP perspective (we see these consistently during integrations):

- Please confirm whether StagingAI requires a remittance to an EU entity (we support per-country remits) or will accept a single US remit with VAT appendix for reclaim.
- Please share your PO series (e.g., PO-STG-2027-xxx) for invoice mirroring.
- For ASAP production: we need your W9 or EU tax residency document for our file. I attached Redwood_W9_and_tax_details.pdf for your records.
- Attachments: once you confirm PO series + remit entity, we will generate a batch invoice for the first quarterly drawdown on 2027-03-15 and route it to billing@stagingai.com.

Action items for Jordan: reply to this thread with (1) PO prefix, (2) remit preference (US single remit vs per-country), and (3) attach W9 or equivalent tax doc. We'll then lock sequences and emit the sample for sign-off.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Manager, Accounts Payable Integrations | Redwood Inference
